issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath R4 tests-fhir-r4.xml testEquality/testEquality7: (1 | 1) = (1 | 2 | {}) must return false
issues.evidence: Fresh full conformance initially failed FHIRPath 934/935 with Expected false, Got []. Native SQL repro also returned empty for arr = 1 and arr != 1.
issues.root_cause: C++ evaluator treated multi-item = and != as empty instead of ordered collection equality with boolean length-mismatch results.
